RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: 40

An all-male panel does not prove discrimination, but it raises the risk of unconscious bias and may violate civil service regulations requiring diverse interview boards. However, the successful candidate also held relevant qualifications, meaning merit may have driven the decision.

Do not make direct bias allegations yet. Instead, follow up firmly on your written feedback and request the interview scoring matrices. Meanwhile, check your ministry’s hiring guidelines to see if panel diversity rules were breached. If HR violated procedural rules or if the feedback reveals subjective or non-job-related scoring, you will have objective grounds to raise the panel's composition through formal grievance or ombuds channels. Raising it without documentation could harm your professional standing.
